card.name: Just before ordinal numbers like 15th
card.fires_on: Linking words or punctuation right before an ordinal number ending in -th, such as 'through' before 'twelfth' or 'and' before 'tenth'. It fires on the small word, not on the ordinal.

modes.label: Ranges of ordinals
modes.description: A joining word between two ordinals, as in grade ranges or day ranges.

modes.label: Before a numbered ordinal
modes.description: A possessive, space or period just before a number-th, such as a ranking or an edition.

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before an ordinal such as 15th or twelfth.
